text:
Four substances, or groups of substances, found in water from a natural source are listed.
1
some metal compounds
2
plastics
3
dissolved oxygen
4
nitrates and phosphates from fertilisers and detergents
Which substances found in water from a natural source can be beneficial to aquatic life?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
